prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1062; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. Imaging was not required at initial evaluation. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and a home exercise program. The mechanism of injury and the forces involved are consistent with the cervical strain diagnosed. Range of motion was reduced on initial examination, and palpable paraspinal muscle tenderness was documented, while neurological screening and strength testing remained within normal limits throughout. Reported symptoms followed an expected recovery pattern, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved. No prior complaints or treatment involving the cervical region are known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing identified. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise, and discharge from active care is anticipated.
